newsitem.title: FRANCE: GDP data support govt 96 growth forecast - Arthuis.
newsitem.headline: GDP data support govt 96 growth forecast - Arthuis.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said gross domestic product data released earlier on Thursday confirmed the government's growth forecast for 1996.
The GDP figures showed that "acquired growth" -- in other words the growth that would be achieved if there were no growth in the fourth quarter -- was 1.2 percent.
"The government's forecast of 1.3 percent growth therefore appears plausible", Arthuis told reporters. "I confirm the 1996 forecast without ambiguity."
GDP rose 0.9 percent in the third quarter after a revised 0.2 percent drop in the second quarter.
